info.name: Garment ERP — Quotations
info.description: All 15 quotation APIs with executable happy-path and alternative lifecycle workflows. Import the paired local environment, migrate/seed MySQL, then start separate fixed-principal Sales and Manager development servers. Defaults: Sales http://127.0.0.1:4100/api/v1 and Manager http://127.0.0.1:4101/api/v1. No tokens or actor headers are invented: identity comes from each server's DEV_ACTOR setting. Run folders in their listed order; each folder creates its own Draft and captures actual returned IDs/versions. Generated dates use companyUtcOffsetMinutes (330 for Asia/Colombo). Running the full collection creates test commercial records and Draft orders in whichever database those servers use. See README.md in this folder for commands.

item.name: 01 — Happy path and idempotent conversion
item.description: Run this folder first. Covers list, create, detail, update, submit, approve, issue, PDF, acceptance and conversion. Replays the original conversion and checks another key returns the same existing order.

request.description: Optional query filters: q, status, customerId, salesTeamId, ownerId, fromDate, toDate. Latest nondeleted revision per family by default; includeRevisions=true returns history.

item.name: Get current revision — refresh version and allowedActions

request.description: Refresh before editing an existing revision. Saves its ID, number and version; inspect allowedActions before calling actions.
Only supplied editable fields change. To replace lines, supply the entire nonempty lines array; line IDs may change. Uses the saved current version.
Uses quoteId and quoteVersion from the most recent successful detail/action response. Failed requests do not change saved IDs or versions.
Uses managerBaseUrl because the approver must differ from the submitter. Both servers connect to the same MySQL database.

Use Send and Download in Postman to save the PDF. Tests verify PDF content type and attachment header. Does not change status.
Records a staff-reported buyer response for the active, unexpired issued offer. Does not send email or perform e-signing.
Generates an idempotency key once and freezes the accepted version for all retries. Stores salesOrderId. Does not replace quoteVersion with the order version.

exec: pm.test('Draft order, exact quote total', function () { pm.expect(data.status).to.equal('Draft'); pm.expect(data.total).to.equal('5500.00'); pm.expect(data.sourceQuotationId).to.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get('quoteId')); });
